facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mary found a secret garden behind a wall. It was old and quiet. Mary went there every day. She pulled weeds and planted seeds. She cared for the garden.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mary Lennox had never cared for anything before. But the secret garden changed her. She found the hidden door and stepped inside. The garden was old and full of dead branches, but Mary saw hope in it. She cared for the garden as if it were a living friend.
facts.Word cards: cared = 돌봤다 / joy = 기쁨 / purpose = 목적 / routine = 일과
